finding.statement: Let g>=2, n>=1, C^n the n-fold fibre product of the closed universal curve over M_g, and k=vcd(M_{g,n})=4g-4+n. Because W_kH^k(M_{g,n}) is the image of W_kH^k(C^n) under the open restriction, because H^k(C^n) splits as a direct sum of mixed Hodge structures H^{k-|i|}(M_g; tensor_s R^{i_s}pi_*Q) over multi-indices i in {0,1,2}^n via the Deninger-Murre relative Chow-Kunneth projectors, and because H^p(M_g;L)=0 for every rational local system L and every p>vcd(M_g)=4g-5, every multi-index with |i|<=n sits in base degree k-|i|>=4g-4>4g-5 and vanishes; hence every surviving summand has some i_s=2 and W_{vcd}H^{vcd}(M_{g,n};Q)=sum_i psi_i sum_j pi_j^* W_{vcd-2}H^{vcd-2}(M_{g,n-1};Q). The peel is available because vcd(M_{g,n})-n=4g-4 exceeds vcd(M_g)=4g-5 by exactly one for every n>=1. Consequently the exact ordinary target is Tate whenever W_{vcd-2}H^{vcd-2}(M_{g,n-1};Q) is Tate, which the recorded CKgP range supplies exactly when n-1<=c(g).
